name: Warsong Saw Blades
summary: At the Warsong Lumber Camp, saw blades keep the Horde's logging machines cutting in Ashenvale. The Warsong Clan depends on goblin-made machinery to harvest lumber across the forest.

sections.title: Industrial Forestry
sections.body: In Ashenvale, the Warsong Clan depends on heavy machinery supplied and maintained by goblin engineers. Axes cannot meet the Horde's demand for Kalimdor lumber, so steam engines and circular saws cut the timber. Ashenvale's ancient hardwood quickly dulls and breaks ordinary blades. Fresh saw blades must reach the mills at the Warsong Lumber Camp to keep them running.

sections.title: Securing the Shipment
sections.body: Parts must cross disputed territory, where hostile furbolgs and satyrs often intercept logging supplies. Goblin contacts such as Pixel at Splintertree Post handle the saw blade shipments. Lumber master Locke Okarr gathers blades with rope, oil, and axes, keeping the camp operating despite sabotage from Ashenvale's defenders.

faq.q: What are the Warsong Saw Blades used for?
faq.answer: The blades replace parts in the circular saws and heavy lumber machinery at the Warsong Lumber Camp in southeastern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who provides these saw blades to the Horde?
faq.answer: Goblin merchants and logisticians handle the blades. Pixel, a goblin at Splintertree Post, oversees their arrival for the Warsong outriders.

faq.q: Why does the Horde need so many saw blades?
faq.answer: Ashenvale's dense, ancient trees quickly wear down cutting edges. The Horde needs great quantities of timber to build settlements across the arid plains of Durotar and the Barrens. Constant logging wears out machinery faster than local smiths can reforge it.

faq.q: Who is collecting the logging supplies?
faq.answer: Locke Okarr, an orc who oversees supply runs from Splintertree Post, organizes the collection of saw blades, oil, ropes, and axes for delivery to the lumber camp.

angles.text: The Horde's expansion into central Kalimdor depends on Ashenvale timber. Keeping Warsong milling equipment in repair is a strategic priority.
As a night elf, you see each crate of goblin-forged saw blades as another assault on Ashenvale's ancient canopy and its sacred woodland spirits.
